data.one_liner: Type‑safe Either monad for handling errors without exceptions in Dart/Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides Left/Right containers to represent failures and successes, with synchronous and asynchronous transformation methods. Includes extensions for Future<Either> to simplify async error handling.
use_when: You need functional‑style error handling instead of try/catch
You want to chain async operations while propagating errors
You prefer explicit success/failure types over nullable values
avoid_when: You require a full state‑management solution
You need built‑in networking or JSON serialization
strengths: Clear separation of error and success paths
Supports both sync and async pipelines
weaknesses: Adds boilerplate of wrapping values in Either
Limited to error handling; not a full framework

alternatives.name: async
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides Future utilities but lacks explicit Either type for error handling
